verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports show developers building embedded signing by creating embedded envelope signing URLs via the eSignature REST API. One built a POC in an hour and shipped to production; another praised the thorough documentation. The official Node client also covers sending and signing via the API. One older report says users could break out of the embedded signing page on refresh, and the fix required a legacy API version. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of embedded signing in the pack, details on UI customization or iframe/redirect options, and assurance that the session break-out issue is resolved on current API versions.
